title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 White Peach Razz Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Indulge in the delicate, refreshing sweetness of White Peach Razz with these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. The subtle, juicy notes of white peach combined with a hint of raspberry offer a uniquely enjoyable MTL vaping experience. Infused with Nic-Salt vape juice, these pods provide a smooth, rich flavour profile and fast relief from nicotine cravings. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
